title: Juvenile Delinquency
pdf_title: STATE-WISE PERCENTAGE CONTRIBUTION TO JUVENILE DELINQUENCY(IPC) DURING 1992 State-wise and Crime-Head-wise distribution of Juvenile delinquency under the IPC (Table-37) shows that Maharashtra had the highest contribution of 29 per cent followed by Madhya Pradesh 22.2 per cent and Gujarat 10.3 per cent. These 3 states together contributed more than 60 per cent of the total cases registered in the country. The other states which registered more than 500 cases during the year are Bihar (746), Tamil Nadu (728), Andhra Pradesh (711) and Rajasthan (577). As against this, Uttar Pradesh, which is the largest populated state registered only 30 cases, sharing just 0.3 per cent. Among the UTs, Delhi alone registered 206 cases (82.4%) of the total cases registered in all the 7 UTs
